task: Draft a title, axis labels, legend labels, and a brief caption for a stacked bar chart showing titles published by genre over three years. Use the supplied counts exactly; do not combine categories or add year-over-year trend claims beyond what the counts support.

facts.text: The chart shows the number of titles published by genre for a fictional press in 2021, 2022, and 2023.
The three genres are Fiction, Non-fiction, and Poetry.
Each bar represents one year; each segment within the bar represents one genre.

forbidden_additions: A year-over-year trend claim beyond what the supplied counts directly show.
preserve: All three genres with all three years and exact counts.
Stacked bar structure with year on the x-axis.
Per-year totals derivable from the supplied counts without invented figures.
